issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וְעַיִר פֶּרֶא אָדָם יִוָּלֵד' means 'and a wild donkey's foal is born a man' (i.e., a person is born like a wild donkey's colt, implying foolishness). The Chinese '野驢的騾駒必被人所生' says 'the mule colt of a wild donkey will be born by a man,' which reverses the subject/object: in Hebrew, the man is born (as a wild donkey's colt), not the colt being born by a man. This changes who is born and the meaning.
